name: hands the running client the shortcut’s arguments; the client opens the game’s page, and the launch hands over to Play

result.command: "{tmp}\Riot Games\Riot Client\RiotClientServices.exe" --launch-product=valorant --launch-patchline=live (the Riot Client opened the game's page: Auto-launch is disabled)
